# BEEPBACK

Five buttons, five tones. The Flipper plays a sequence and you play it back,
one step longer every time. Then it starts changing the rules on you.

## Modes

- **CLASSIC** — the sequence grows a step at a time. Three lives.
- **RULES** — every round hands you a rule to obey. SKIP DOWN means the
  sequence plays DOWN and you do not press it. Also SWAP, BACKWARDS, NO
  DOUBLES, EVERY OTHER, DOUBLE and LAST TWICE.
- **REFLEX** — one cue at a time, hit before the bar empties. The window
  shrinks with every hit and one miss ends the run.
- **CHALLENGE** — pick a rule and keep it. One sequence that never stops
  growing.
- **DAILY** — one seeded run a day, the same one for every Flipper in the
  world. Resets at midnight.

## Playing

Four assists decide what you get besides the sound: **EARS** is tone only,
**LED** lights each button its own colour, **SHAPES** draws a shape per button
and **ARROWS** draws the button itself. Each keeps its own records, so playing
by ear competes against playing by ear.

**HAPTIC** works alongside any of them. The motor traces every note of every
pattern, so with the volume off you can play a sequence by feel.

Ten points a note, a hundred for clearing a round, and no hidden multiplier.
Every combination of mode, time, speed and assist keeps its own record, and
STATS counts your runs, playtime, rounds cleared and longest sequence.

BACK pauses a run and is the way back everywhere else. From the menu, LEFT and
RIGHT walk along to stats, records and the credits.
